Subject: Need help with a land dispute case

Hello, my name is Thomas Patel. I am a 65-year-old mechanical engineer living in Mumbai. I have a land dispute with Vandana Mittal over land worth INR 3,29,00,000/-, and construction has started on the disputed plot. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 89330 32665 or email thomas.patel78@example.in.
